Zhang2022_Brain_vs_Lung_Stromal_Immune_R.key_mechanism: In primary lung stroma (TIME-L vs L), T-cell receptor & chemokine recruitment genes (TRAC +1.89, IL2RG +1.81, ITGAL/LFA-1 +1.80, CXCL13 +2.01, CXCL9 +1.70, LTB +1.66) are strongly enriched while M2/scavenger receptors (CD163, MRC1, LRP1, VSIG4, MSR1, CSF1R, CD68) are absent at |Log2FC|>=1.5. In brain metastasis stroma (TIME-B vs LB), TRAC, IL2RG, ITGAL, CXCL13, CXCL9, and LTB are completely lost and replaced by a massive M2/Complement/LRP1/APOE/VSIG4 myeloid wall (APOE +3.35, C1QC +2.96, C1QA +2.90, C1QB +2.81, CD163 +2.68, VSIG4 +2.20, CD14 +2.18, FCGR3A +2.18, TYROBP +2.05, LRP1 +1.81, MSR1 +1.78, MRC1 +1.69, CD68 +1.68, CSF1R +1.54), shifting the stromal immune balance by p = 1.95e-6.
